title: 92% of Indian firms hit an AI agent security incident
takeaways: 92% had an AI agent security incident in the past year.
Only 36% of them contained it within 24 hours.
37% found unregistered AI agents running in production.
Just 19% name one owner for agent security governance.
DPDP penalties for weak safeguards go up to ₹250 crore.
source_note: Sources: ServiceNow (Nov 2026); DPDP Rules 2025 via PIB
